study: A13-R3 Gemini-2.5-Flash agent + boundary-safe Llama scorer replication
scientific_status: prospective proprietary-agent robustness replication frozen after A13/R1/R1B/R2 but before any R3 AgentDojo outcome
pre_outcome_technical_amendment: Custom OpenAILLM instances have name=None in AgentDojo 0.1.35, which prevents TraceLogger/OutputLogger from writing benchmark logs. Set an explicit deterministic pipeline name only; no task population, mapper, endpoint, scorer, or inference changed.
provider_routing_policy: OpenRouter default routing with frozen model ID/base URL; no explicit upstream-provider pin

taxonomy.source: exact frozen A13 taxonomy; no R3 relabeling

mapping.name: monotonic_same_function_max_argument_overlap_v1
mapping.candidate_rule: unused same-function actual privileged calls strictly after the previous mapped actual call
mapping.selection_rule: choose candidate with maximum normalized GT-vs-actual argument overlap; exact ties choose earliest actual call
mapping.overlap_definition: fraction over union of argument keys with normalized_text(gt[k]) == normalized_text(actual[k]); empty union=1

span_eligibility: prior role=="tool" message with non-empty stripped textual content; tiny nonempty included; empty excluded

ablation.primary: true deletion of U and every eligible tool message

boundary_safe_scoring.invariant: completion token count/hash must be identical across full, U deletion/substitution, and every S deletion/substitution

inference.task_weighting: equal weight per task within label

population_reporting.qwen_gemini_common_support: decision IDs primary-valid in R3 and present in fixed-valid R1B; Qwen trajectories use the same boundary-safe Llama scorer
population_reporting.llama_gemini_common_support: decision IDs primary-valid in both R2 and R3 under the same boundary-safe Llama scorer
population_reporting.three_way_common_support: decision IDs primary-valid in R3, fixed-valid R1B, and primary-valid R2
population_reporting.strict_action_matched_support: descriptive subset requiring exact normalized final-action signature match

diagnostic_only_path_fields.assistant_argument_echo_fraction_definit: fraction of final-action atomic argument values with normalized length >=4 that appear in prior assistant content/tool-call serialization
diagnostic_only_path_fields.nearest_prior_tool_result_definition: last eligible non-empty tool message before the target action; record exact-text and normalized-text SHA256 for cross-agent diagnostics
